read.thesis: Quanta raised FY26 guidance across all metrics (adj. EPS $16.45–$16.95, revenue $39.3–39.7B) on Q2 revenue of $9.56B, up 41%, with backlog at a record $53.4B; but growth leans on acquisitions and capex is held at about $0.9B net.

triggers.label: Adj. EPS guide raised to $16.45–$16.95
triggers.quote: Quanta now expects diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock to range between $11.41 and $11.92 and adjusted diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock to range between $16.45 and $16.95.

triggers.label: Total backlog record $53.4B
triggers.quote: Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) of $33.6 Billion* and Total Backlog of $53.4 Billion*

triggers.label: Acquisitions add $1.2–1.4B revenue
triggers.quote: Quanta expects these acquisitions to contribute approximately $1.2 billion - $1.4 billion of revenues and approximately $120 million to $140 million of adjusted EBITDA.

guidance.quote: Quanta now expects revenues to range between $39.3 billion and $39.7 billion
adjusted diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock to range between $16.45 and $16.95
adjusted EBITDA to range between $4.09 billion and $4.21 billion
free cash flow (a financial measure) to range between $2.00 billion and $2.50 billion
